issue.title: bob gcal doctor prints the gog version as vv0.44.0

task_type_fields.impact: Cosmetic only: human and JSON doctor output disagree with the documented `v0.44.0 · <path>` summary. No check result changes.
task_type_fields.repro:
Run `bob gcal doctor` on any host with gog installed. The gog row prints the version with a doubled `v`:

- athena: `✓ gog               vv0.44.0 · /home/bryan/bin/gog`
- Mac: `✓ gog               vv0.47.1 · /Users/bbugyi/bin/gog`

Root cause: `src/native/gcal/doctor.rs:88` formats `"v{version} · {}"`, but `Gog::version()` (`src/native/gcal/gog.rs:157`) returns gog's own version token, which already starts with `v` (`gog --version` → `v0.44.0 (cf42bb7c …)`). The `-f json` doctor summary carries the same string. docs/gcal.md § Doctor shows the intended `v0.44.0 · /opt/homebrew/bin/gog`.

Fix: drop the literal `v` prefix (or strip a leading `v` before formatting) and add a doctor test with a fake gog that reports `v0.44.0`.

issue.creation_reason: Found while comparing bob gcal doctor output on athena and the Mac for the Mac gcal setup research; the doctor gog row doubles the v prefix.

payload.description: Ranking open task beads; list JSON omitted these descriptions

evidence.note: Gmail landing (bob-cli-hg.land) on master d5e49b17: the new src/native/gmail/doctor.rs copied the same "v{version} · {}" format, so bob gmail doctor printed '✓ gog vv0.44.0 · <path>' through real gog v0.44.0 (isolated throwaway client). The landing fixed only the Gmail copy (trim_start_matches('v') plus a fake-gog test with a v-prefixed version, tests/gmail_shell.rs doctor_prints_a_v_prefixed_gog_version_once); src/native/gcal/doctor.rs:59 still has the bug and can use the same one-line fix.
